meta_description: Cutting Edge delivers expert landscape gardening across Newcastle and Wallsend. Design, planting, and maintenance. Call for a free quote today.
hero_subhead: Transform your garden into an outdoor space you'll love spending time in. From design to planting and ongoing care.
services_heading: Complete Landscape Gardening Services Across Newcastle
services_subhead: Whether you need a full garden redesign, planting schemes, or regular maintenance, we handle every aspect of landscape gardening.

services.title: Garden Design & Planning
services.desc: Bespoke designs tailored to your space, budget, and vision. We create detailed plans and 3D visualisations before any work begins.

services.title: Hard Landscaping
services.desc: Patios, decking, pathways, and fencing installed to professional standards. Durable materials built to last decades in the North East climate.

services.title: Planting & Borders
services.desc: Seasonal colour schemes, shrub borders, and planting that thrives in Newcastle's conditions. We choose plants for year-round interest.

services.title: Lawn Installation & Repair
services.desc: New turf laying or seed sowing. We also renovate tired lawns with aeration, feeding, and moss control.

services.title: Garden Maintenance
services.desc: Regular upkeep including pruning, weeding, hedge trimming, and seasonal care. Monthly or quarterly visits to keep your garden looking fresh.

services.title: Water Features & Lighting
services.desc: Ponds, fountains, and outdoor lighting to add ambiance and focal points. Professional installation with years of reliability in mind.

about_pullquote: We design gardens people actually want to spend time in.
about_para_1: Cutting Edge was founded on the belief that every garden, no matter its size, deserves professional care and attention. Over 15 years, we've helped Newcastle homeowners and business owners reimagine their outdoor spaces. Our team combines horticultural knowledge with design flair — we know what grows in the North East, and we know how to make it look stunning.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on listening. We don't impose a one-size-fits-all approach; instead, we take time to understand your garden's potential, your lifestyle, and your budget. Nine in ten of our clients come back for ongoing maintenance or recommend us to friends and family — that's the kind of trust we've earned through honest work and results.
reviews_heading: What Newcastle Homeowners Say About Cutting Edge

reviews.text: Brilliant from start to finish. We had no idea what we wanted to do with our back garden, and the lads helped us plan it out. Six weeks later it's completely transformed. They're tidy, professional, and actually knew what they were doing. Can't recommend them enough.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Had my patio done and new borders planted last spring. Looks amazing still. Came back for maintenance over the summer and they were just as friendly and efficient. Fair pricing, no hidden costs. Will definitely use them again.
reviews.author: Claire W.

reviews.text: After three years of poor maintenance from another company, we gave Cutting Edge a go. They cleared everything up, redesigned it properly, and now visit monthly to keep it tidy. The difference is night and day. Top job.
reviews.author: David H.
